wordingChanges.old: July 24, 1920 administration explicitly included Kolguyev, Novaya Zemlya, Vaygach and other governorate islands (GAOO R-211/1/1, folio 115 verso).
wordingChanges.replacement: On 24 July 1920 the provincial executive committee approved a draft island-administration regulation naming Kolguyev, Novaya Zemlya, Vaygach and Yugorsky Shar (GAOO R-211/1/1, folio 115 verso). This is provincial administrative evidence, not final VTsIK approval.

wordingChanges.old: March 25, 1922 regulation specifically covered Novaya Zemlya, Vaygach and Kolguyev (R-211/1/41, folios 22 verso and 46).
wordingChanges.replacement: On 25 March 1922 the provincial executive committee approved a draft regulation covering Novaya Zemlya, Vaygach and Kolguyev (R-211/1/41, folios 22 verso and 46). It was returned from Moscow for revision; this date is not final central ratification.

wordingChanges.old: June 30, 1924 VTsIK regulation again named Kolguyev (RSFSR laws 1924 no. 59, article 582). September 1924 created the Kolguyev island council at Bugrino.
wordingChanges.replacement: On 30 June 1924 the VTsIK presidium finally approved the island-administration regulation, expressly including Kolguyev (RSFSR laws 1924 no. 59, article 582). The provincial committee approved a Kolguyev council at Bugrino in September 1924.

whyClarify: The original report omitted the distinction between provincially approved drafts and final central ratification. Clarify explicitly rather than letting a reader infer that 1920/1922 was final VTsIK approval.
